text:
maria: Quick proposal — spike to simplify prefix ownership API into bounded leases + idempotent owner tokens. attaching a lightweight sketch for discussion.

maria: sketch: keep handshake tiny so runtime can make strong guarantees about eviction correctness and fast failover. idea: explicit Acquire/Release + Renew.

maria: ```proto
service PrefixLease {
  rpc Acquire(AcquireReq) returns (AcquireResp);
  rpc Renew(RenewReq) returns (RenewResp);
  rpc Release(ReleaseReq) returns (ReleaseResp);
}

message AcquireReq { string prefix; int64 lease_ms; }
message AcquireResp { bool ok; string owner_token; int64 expires_at; }
```

devon: This is appealing. two immediate Qs: 1) how do we avoid split-brain if Renew races with demote/evict? 2) what happens when owner_token is lost (process crash)?

irene: For (1) we could encode an epoch in owner_token and require the evict path to check token epoch before marking demoted. For (2) clients should treat owner_token as opaque and use server-side garbage-collection when lease expires.

devon: Epoch in token helps, but how do we reconcile with current prefix handoff where we do multi-step transfer (lock -> snapshot -> commit)? can this API express safe handoff without the long handshake?

maria: Handshake remains necessary only for hot prefix transfers. For most cases the bounded-lease model lets us avoid global locks: prefetchers acquire short leases and rely on KV atomic ops to abort if they see a newer epoch. For transfer we add a temporary exclusive Acquire with special flag `exclusive=true` that rejects concurrent acquires.

sam: What about soft-evict semantics (grace credits)? Today we allow tenants a soft window to continue reads. Does a lease expiration instantly drop residency or do we keep a grace period?

irene: Keep a small grace window (configurable) to avoid thundering cold starts. Implementation: lease_expires -> mark candidate for demote, still serve reads for grace_ms unless memory pressure requires immediate eviction. telemetry should track demote->evict latency.

devon: Sounds OK. Need clear invariants: 1) owner_token proves authority for writes to prefix until expires; 2) exclusive Acquire prevents new prefetchers; 3) demote only proceeds if no valid owner_token exists or eviction urgency override.

maria: Agreed. Also propose an idempotent `Release(owner_token)` so owners can proactively release on shutdown; server rejects release if token epoch mismatch.

sam: Rollout plan? I think we can land API + server-side compatibility shim that accepts old handshake for transfers. Backwards compat: existing handoff RPCs still callable but map to `Acquire(exclusive=true)` under the hood.

maria: Rollout: (a) implement Acquire/Renew/Release on dev cluster behind feature flag, (b) add token epoch & telemetry, (c) run canary with prefetcher clients, (d) flip for non-critical prefixes, (e) migrate hot handoffs last.

devon: Tests to add: concurrency fuzz for Acquire vs Renew vs Release, eviction under memory pressure while renew inflight, and crash-recovery where owner token disappears mid-flight.

irene: Ops note: add metric `prefix_lease_conflict` and `lease_grace_demote_ms` and trace spans for Acquire->Renew->Release. Also add invariant check in debug builds: if exclusive Acquire returns ok, no other owner_token should exist in same epoch.

maria: One concern: this relaxes the requirement that a handoff waits for a snapshot to land. we must ensure our write-paths use conditional CAS with owner_token when the prefix is owned. Otherwise we risk lost writes.

sam: Good point — require write-path to include `owner_token` header when prefix is marked owned, server rejects writes without token or with stale token. fallback for read-only workloads allowed.

devon: Action items: 1) maria to draft RFC with API + compatibility mapping (this week) 2) irene to list telemetry and metrics (by EOD) 3) sam to prototype server-side token GC and grace window (next week) 4) devon to author concurrency tests (next week).

ci-bot: FYI — existing handoff tests: 12 failing tests referencing `handoff.*` expected. please run `./dev/run_handoff_tests --lease-mode` after prototype.

maria: Thanks — will iterate on the RFC draft and add handoff mapping appendix. tagging @devon @irene for early review. :thumbsup:
